name: Showreel Blocks
tagline: Showreel's motion-graphics reel: flat primary colour blocks, giant numbers, block wipes on the beat.

motion.direction: Showreel motion graphics. Every section looks like a different project: a flat `bleedPlate` with `patternId: "solid"` or `"blocks"` and a 1–3 word title for each new idea, giant `counter`s (250–320 px) for numbers that count up over 1.2–1.8 s, `chips` as a stack that lands one per beat, `chapterCard`s for sections, straight `imageCard`s with a block label. Big move, short time: entries slide in hard, exits cut 0.1 s before the next. Never the same transition three times in a row — alternate plate, chips, counter, card. A layout never holds longer than 4 s. No serif lines, no vignette moods, no film strips.
